description: This file defines the 'Sale' class within the OpenCart administrative model extension report namespace. It contains various methods to generate statistical data about sales, such as total sales, orders by country, orders by day/week/month/year, and taxes. The class extends a system engine model and interacts with the database to retrieve and compute sales-related data, likely used to generate reports within the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Represents the sales report model in the OpenCart admin extension. Provides methods to calculate various sales metrics over different time periods and categories, facilitating sales analysis and reporting.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates the total sales amount, optionally filtered by date.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Retrieves total number of orders and total amount grouped by country with ISO code.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByDay
methods.description: Provides total orders data broken down by each day.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByWeek
methods.description: Provides total orders data grouped by week.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByMonth
methods.description: Provides total orders data grouped by month.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByYear
methods.description: Provides total orders data grouped by year.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders with detailed statistics, with filtering options.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Calculates total tax amounts, optionally filtered by order status, date range, etc.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders, optionally grouped by day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Gets shipping data including start/end dates, total, and number of orders, with filtering options.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Calculates total shipping costs, optionally filtered by date and grouping.

methods.name: getTotalTaxes
methods.description: Calculates total tax amounts, optionally grouped by date period for different report views.
